21. 圖中，O 為圓 ABCDEF 的圓心。ΔPQR 與該圓相交於 A、B、C、D、E 及 F。若 ∠QPR = 38° 及 AB = CD = EF，則 ∠QOR =

A. 109°
B. 117°
C. 123°
D. 142°
reasoning: Since chords AB, CD, and EF are of equal length in the same circle, they are equidistant from the center O. The lines PQ, QR, and RP contain these chords, so the perpendicular distance from point O to each side of triangle PQR is the same. This implies that O is the incenter of triangle PQR. In any triangle PQR with incenter O, the angle ∠QOR is related to the opposite angle ∠QPR by the formula ∠QOR = 90° + ∠QPR / 2. Given ∠QPR = 38°, we have ∠QOR = 90° + 38° / 2 = 90° + 19° = 109°.
